title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #1: Bahia Todos Santos coast with geologic units and faults
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph mounted on a white card, marked "#1" with "N" at top and a circled number in the corner. Handwritten geologic annotations include "Bahia Todos Santos", "Mesozoic igneous rocks" and "Quaternary alluvium", with dashed lines tracing linear features (faults) across mountainous terrain. Dark ocean occupies the lower-left corner.
